device.label: Device
device.nodeDefaultTitle: Run with no deviceKey — the node answers on its default pool
device.noAccelerators: no probed accelerators on this node

runTarget.title: Run target — camera · node · device
runTarget.noDetection: No detection block — this camera is not currently dispatched anywhere. The tree below is what WOULD run.

audio.needsReference: Audio bench needs a reference file: runAudioTest has no field for an uploaded WAV, and a payload without a filename makes the provider classify the first reference file in its directory instead.
audio.uploadUnsupported: Upload is not supported for audio: runAudioTest has no payload field for an uploaded file, so "{{name}}" cannot be classified. Pick a reference WAV above.
audio.referenceOnly: Reference files only — runAudioTest has no payload field for an uploaded WAV, so an upload can be waveform-previewed but never classified.

plan.chooseDevice: Choose at least one device and model.

preflight.node: Node under test: {{node}}. Its detection leaves it for the run and comes back when it ends.
preflight.noneMoving: No camera runs on this node now.
preflight.pinned: (pinned here — the pin is restored after)
preflight.staying: {{count}} camera(s) cannot move — this node is their only frame source: {{list}}. They keep running here and the results are marked contaminated.
preflight.estimated: Estimated: up to {{estimate}}; the run stops and restores the cluster after {{budget}} at the latest.

run.aborted: Stopped ({{reason}}) — the cluster was restored; {{count}} result(s) kept.
run.abortDescription: The run stops; what it finished is kept, and the cluster is restored as it was.
run.stayed: Stayed on the node (only frame source): {{list}} — results marked contaminated.

endReason.drain-timeout: cameras did not leave the node in time

standing.fresh: Used by Auto tune and the shares

devices.title: Devices and candidate models
devices.note: Each ticked model gets a device-capacity ramp; the first one per device also runs the pipeline measurement. Models not on the node are downloaded for the run and removed after.
devices.noteKept: Each ticked model gets a device-capacity ramp; the first one per device also runs the pipeline measurement. Models not on the node are downloaded for the run and removed after — kept, as you chose.

results.title: Results — {{node}}
results.empty: No results for this node yet
results.emptyHint: Auto tune and the automatic shares use the latency table for it until it is benchmarked.

node.title: Node
node.intro: One node at a time. While it runs, the node takes no detection: its cameras move to the other nodes and come back — pins included — when it ends, also after a crash or a hub restart.
node.cluster: Cluster now: {{now}} parallel session(s); the other nodes can carry {{capacity}}.

measure.title: What to measure
measure.noSteps: The node's catalog offers no detail step.
measure.acceptHeadroom: Start although the other nodes cannot carry every session
